chapter_name: How do I Spend my Day
learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about the different parts of the day and the fun things we do in them!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The bright sun comes up and we wake up! We brush our teeth and eat a yummy breakfast to start our day.
In the afternoon, the sun is high and we eat lunch. In the evening, the sun goes down and we play outside with our friends!
At night, the sky gets dark and the stars twinkle. We put on our pajamas and go to sleep in our cozy beds.
We do things in a special order. We wash our hands before we eat our food. We wash our hands after we play in the mud!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Daily Routine Drawing
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a bright yellow sun for your morning time and a shiny moon for your night time. Tell your parents one fun thing you do during each time!

quick_recap: ⭐ Our beautiful day is made of morning, afternoon, evening, and night.
⭐ We always wash our hands before eating and play after finishing our work.
